description: This file contains benchmark tests for various container types in the Abseil C++ library, including btree, flat_hash, and standard containers, focusing on performance metrics such as insertion, lookup, deletion, and iterator operations.

classes.name: BigType
classes.description: A customizable large value type used for benchmarking container performance with different object sizes and copy costs.

classes.name: BigTypePtr
classes.description: A wrapper around a unique_ptr to BigType, used for benchmarking container performance with large objects managed via smart pointers.

methods.name: GenerateValues
methods.description: Generates a vector of values in the range [0, 4 * n], with seed 23.

methods.name: BM_InsertImpl
methods.description: Benchmarks insertion and re-insertion of values into a container, with optional sorting.

methods.name: BM_Insert
methods.description: Runs the insertion benchmark without sorting.

methods.name: BM_InsertSorted
methods.description: Runs the insertion benchmark with sorted input.

methods.name: BM_InsertSmall
methods.description: Benchmarks inserting a small number of elements into a container, simulating root growth in a B-tree.

methods.name: BM_LookupImpl
methods.description: Benchmarks lookup performance in a container, with optional sorted input.

methods.name: BM_FullLookup
methods.description: Runs the lookup benchmark on a fully-inserted container.

methods.name: BM_Erase
methods.description: Benchmarks erasing and re-inserting values in a container.

methods.name: BM_EraseRange
methods.description: Benchmarks range erasure and reinsertion of values.

methods.name: BM_EraseIf
methods.description: Benchmarks erasing elements based on a predicate.

methods.name: BM_QueueAddRem
methods.description: Simulates queue-like insertions and removals, counting value constructors.

methods.name: BM_MixedAddRem
methods.description: Benchmarks mixed insertion and removal in the same range.

methods.name: BM_FwdIter
methods.description: Benchmarks forward iteration over a container.

methods.name: BM_RangeConstructionImpl
methods.description: Benchmarks range construction of containers, with optional sorting.

methods.name: ContainerInfo
methods.description: Calculates container memory usage info for BigType and BigTypePtr.
